prompts.title: Full-Stack WP DevOps
prompts.description: Full-Stack WP DevOps: plan, build, extend, verify, and review WordPress themes, plugins, add-ons, and Core patches across the full development lifecycle. Fill in the task and run Full-Stack WP DevOps in one step.
prompts.content:
# Full-Stack WP DevOps

Run /fswpdevops and help me with the task below. Talk to me in plain words and ask only what you need from me.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Stage:** `{{stage}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Before you create, change, send, publish, or delete anything, show a short plan and wait for my yes. Read-only checks run without it.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what you need in your own words.
task.context: What goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow.

stage.label: Stage
stage.context: Pick the step to run. Not sure: leave it on the first option and the entry skill decides. Skills: FSWPDevOps API Developer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-api; FSWPDevOps Architect = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-architect; FSWPDevOps Block Developer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-block; FSWPDevOps DevOps Engineer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-ci; FSWPDevOps Core Contributor = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-core; FSWPDevOps Maintainer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-maintainer; FSWPDevOps Performance Engineer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-performance; FSWPDevOps Plugin Developer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-plugin; FSWPDevOps QA Engineer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-qa; FSWPDevOps Release Manager = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-release; FSWPDevOps Reviewer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-reviewer; FSWPDevOps Security Engineer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-security; FSWPDevOps Theme Developer = /fswpdevops:fswpdevops-theme.
